cycles.cardDescription: Close the group's books at an instant, and see what has become of every cycle the group has asked for. A plan appears on a cycle once the settlement worker has computed it.
cycles.asOfHint: The instant the cycle settles as of: everything recorded at or before it, and not already settled, is what it will settle. It is required, and it is what identifies the cycle - the same instant asked for twice is one settlement.
cycles.opened: Cycle opened for {at}. A plan appears here once the worker has computed it.
cycles.alreadyComputed: {at} was already settled. The plan over it is below.
cycles.empty: This group has not closed its books yet. Opening a cycle is what starts a settlement.
cycles.caption: The group's settlement cycles

runs.title: Settlement plans
runs.lede: Every run this group has computed, newest first. A run is the plan for one group cycle: who pays whom, and what it costs. Opening one is how a member reads it before saying yes.
runs.cardDescription: Each line is one cycle's plan. The amount shown is the net movement in that currency, not a total across currencies.
runs.caption: The group's settlement runs
runs.empty: This group has not computed a settlement plan yet. A plan is computed for a closed cycle.

partitions.title: Figures per currency
partitions.description: Gross is what was owed before netting, net is what moves as a result of it, tax is what the plan pays on the settlement, and the saving is what netting avoided.
partitions.caption: The plan's figures per currency

transfers.title: Who pays whom
transfers.description: Every movement the plan asks for, in the order the rail will be given them.
transfers.caption: The plan's instructions
transfers.empty: This plan asks for no movements: everything nets to nothing in every currency.

answers.title: Answers on the record
answers.description: Every answer a member has given, including any that cannot count. Whether an answer counted is the run's judgement, and the plan's status is where that shows.
answers.caption: Answers to this run
answers.empty: Nobody has answered this plan yet.

status.unknown: A state this screen does not know

gates.notYetLooked: The settlement worker has not looked at this plan yet, so nothing is known about its approvals.
gates.quorumMet: {counted} of {required} approvals needed - this plan has them.
gates.quorumShort: {counted} of {required} approvals so far, so {missing} short.
gates.debtorsToConfirm: {count, plural, one {# member who owes money still has to confirm} other {# members who owe money still have to confirm}}.
gates.fundingSatisfied: The group has brought in every currency the plan needs.
gates.fundingMissing: The group still has to bring in:
gates.stale: This conclusion is about an earlier state of the plan, which has changed since.

decision.title: Your answer
decision.description: An answer is recorded against this plan and the plan's own arithmetic decides what it means. A member has one answer per plan, and it is never overwritten.
decision.recorded: Recorded: {decision}. Whether it counts is the plan's own decision, and its status is where that shows.
decision.alreadyAnswered: This member has already answered this plan, and an answer is never overwritten. The answer on the record is the one above.
